verdict.rationale: Hardware backends are a fair question for an LLM inference engine, so the axis applies. The evidence only says vLLM generally supports AMD GPUs. Nothing mentions a Vulkan backend or running on AMD without a ROCm install, so general AMD support is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
